_readme: Fares for the trip planner. Shipped with an empty 'bands' on purpose: that is the
published fare table, and nothing in this repo is allowed to guess at one. While bands
is empty the app still shows a fare, because someone planning by cost needs a number,
but computes it itself and tags every option 'Fare estimated'.
To show real fares, fill in bands from the published table (Public Transport Council,
TransitLink, or an LTA dataset) and set source, url and effective. Nothing else to do -
the app picks it up on reload and the tag disappears.
Singapore charges ONE distance fare for a whole journey, transfers included, so bands
are looked up once against the total ridden distance - never once per leg. Walking and
bands: [{max_km, fare}, ...] - the app sorts them and takes the first band whose max_km
covers the distance, falling back to the last band for anything longer.
